unsent.title: Unsent message
unsent.body: What you are writing is saved as a draft in this browser and comes back when you reopen the ticket. Unsent attachments are not kept.

greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.body: Hi {{customerName}}, this is AI SUPER OFFICE support. We have received your request {{ticketNumber}}.

ask_version.label: Ask for app version and OS
ask_version.body: Could you tell us which app version you are using and your operating system (Windows / macOS, with its version)? That helps us check precisely.

ask_screenshot.label: Ask for a screenshot / video
ask_screenshot.body: Could you send us a screenshot or a short video of the steps that lead to the problem, so we can reproduce it?

investigating.label: We are investigating
investigating.body: We have logged the issue in ticket {{ticketNumber}} and are looking into it with our engineering team. We will update you as soon as we know more.

fixed_update.label: Fixed, please update
fixed_update.body: We have fixed this issue. Please update the app to the latest version and try again.

closing.label: Closing
closing.body: If you need anything else, just reply in ticket {{ticketNumber}}. Thank you for using AI SUPER OFFICE!

shortcuts.description: Shortcuts are ignored while you are typing in a field.
